description: Bluesky PDS (Personal Data Server) container image, compose file, and documentation

summary.one_liner: Official documentation and container setup for self-hosting a Bluesky PDS (Personal Data Server), the AT Protocol account and data server, on a VPS.
summary.what_it_does: The repo provides container images, a Docker compose setup, and documentation for running a Bluesky PDS on a Linux VPS. The README describes an interactive install script that sets up the PDS with Caddy handling TLS on ports 80 and 443, plus a wildcard DNS requirement for user handles. It covers creating accounts and invite codes with the bundled goat CLI, connecting the Bluesky app to a custom PDS, and configuring SMTP for email verification. It also documents logging, OpenTelemetry metrics with an optional Prometheus and Grafana stack in a monitoring/ directory, watchtower-based updates via pdsadmin, a long table of environment variables, and branding options for the sign-in screens. A section explains how to fix a Relay desync by editing the sequencer database cursor.
use_cases: Self-host a Bluesky PDS on a VPS
Run my own AT Protocol account server
Create accounts and invite codes on a personal PDS
Set up SMTP email for a self-hosted PDS
Monitor a PDS with Prometheus and Grafana
Rebrand the sign-in pages of a self-hosted PDS
Fix a Relay desync after migrating a PDS
how_to_run: docker exec pds goat pds admin account create --admin-password PDS_ADMIN_PASSWORD --handle newuser.pds.net --email new-user@email.com --password new-password
docker exec pds goat pds admin --admin-password PDS_ADMIN_PASSWORD create-invites
notable: Interactive installer script that sets up the PDS on a fresh Ubuntu or Debian VPS
Caddy in the bundled compose file handles TLS certificates automatically
Optional self-contained Prometheus, Grafana, and node_exporter monitoring stack bound to localhost
Extensive branding variables for sign-in and authorization screens, including colors and background images
Includes a goat CLI for admin tasks such as account creation and relay status
caveats: The README says the install script assumes a fresh VPS and should not be used alongside an existing web server on ports 80 and 443
The maintainers do not provide tech support for reverse proxy setups other than the bundled Caddy configuration
Requires a public IPv4 address, a public DNS name, and a wildcard DNS record for user handles
